- When sentiment is consistently bullish (≥0.67) over recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; apply downward bias correction by 2–5% for 30d forecasts.
- After sharp price spikes (e.g., >+10% from prior 10d mean), model often overshoots and fails to correct; reduce forecast slope by 10–20% in next 5–7d horizon.
- If official supply net is negative and bullish sentiment is low, model underestimates; adjust upward by 3–8% if supply net < -15 and sentiment < 0.33.
- Mean reversion is strong in 30d forecasts when sentiment is mixed (0.33–0.67); model often holds trend; apply smoothing filter to reduce 3rd–5th day forecast increments.
- When multiple auction events occur in 7d window, model overreacts to early events; delay forecast adjustment by 2–3d and reduce magnitude of response to 1–2% per event.
- If sentiment history shows alternating bullish/bearish cycles, model fails to capture volatility; use 3-period moving average of sentiment to adjust forecast volatility.
